year.description: The foundation inherited from your ancestors and the first footprints you leave on the world.

month.description: Your professional environment and the framework of your social relationships.

day.description: The core of your being and your primordial energy.

hour.description: The manifestation of the legacy you will leave and your future potential.

yearMeaning: The deep significance of the Year Pillar, symbolizing your roots and ancestral energy.
monthMeaning: The energy of the Month Pillar as expressed in social relationships and professional environments.
dayMeaning: The interpretation of the Day Pillar, representing the core of the self and essential tendencies.
hourMeaning: The explanation of the Hour Pillar, showing future potential and the fruits of later life.
yearRepresents: Ancestors, childhood, parental background, and the foundation of life
monthRepresents: Sociality, professional achievement, sibling relationships, and youth
dayRepresents: Myself, spouse, current environment, and middle age
hourRepresents: Children, later life, inner desires, and fruitfulness
